questions.question: According to the manual, the new birth is described as what kind of change?
Who was the head of the human race whose fall changed the course of humanity?
Which of these is listed as a consequence of the fall of man?
options: Loss of communion and fellowship with God

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT what the New Birth is, according to the manual?
options: The quickening of our dead spirit
Being translated from darkness to light

questions.question: What is the first step listed in becoming born again?
options: Acknowledging that you are a sinner

questions.question: Repentance is described as what kind of decision?
options: A firm conscious personal decision to turn from sin to righteousness
A decision made only by pastors

questions.question: Which of these is one of the steps repentance must involve?
Before salvation, the manual says you were a servant of what?
After salvation, how does God see the believer according to the manual?
options: A new person whose sins are washed away and forgotten

questions.question: The manual identifies three baptisms for true believers. Which of these is one of them?
options: Baptism into Christ and His Body

questions.question: What does the Greek word for baptism, 'Baptizo', mean?
Quiet time is described in the manual as time set aside for what?
According to the manual, why do we need quiet time?
options: To cope with daily activities by God's power

questions.question: What is personal evangelism described as?
options: Person-to-person sharing of the gospel to lead someone to Christ

questions.question: According to the manual's teaching on soul-winning, a soul is described as worth more than what?
Restitution is described as involving what action?
options: Restoring to the owner all things taken by falsehood

questions.question: According to the manual, who initiated marriage?
Marriage, according to the manual, should be between whom?
options: There is no biblical guidance given

questions.question: The Second Coming of Christ study says events in the world today show what?
options: The imminence of the Lord's coming
A delay of a thousand years

questions.question: In the first phase of the Lord's coming as described in the manual, He comes for whom?
options: The saints, to remove them from the world

questions.question: How many chapters/points does Study 1 use to describe the fall of man's consequences before discussing God's mercy?
options: Several, including loss of communion, spiritual death, and loss of dominion
None — the fall had no consequences
It focuses solely on physical illness

questions.question: What must a born-again Christian's life reflect, according to the conclusion of Study 1?
options: A difference evident in words, thoughts and actions

questions.question: Which practice does the manual list as a way to live the new life successfully?
options: Giving ourselves to the study of the Word

questions.question: According to Study 4, why must water baptism be by immersion rather than sprinkling?
options: Because 'Baptizo' in Greek means to submerge or immerse, expressing burial and resurrection with Christ
Because the early church had no water
Because immersion is simply a modern preference
